adancurusul-embedded-debugger-mcp-embedd.description: Embedded hardware debugging workflow for probe-rs targets using embedded-debugger-mcp. Use when Codex or Claude Code needs to inspect debug probes, validate embedded debugger setup, start the MCP server, guide a user through ARM Cortex-M/RISC-V flashing/debugging/RTT workflows, or operate without installing an MCP client by using the CLI plus prompts.
